Iranian-Israeli escalation | Child injured under military operations on Syrian lands in Al-Quneitra

Al-Quneitra province: A child in Al-Rafid Village in Al-Quneitra was injured by shrapnel of Iranian missiles in the area, during the military escalation between Iran and Israel in south Syria on borders with the occupied Al-Golan.

On the same context, borders with the occupied Al-Golan witnessed Israeli mobilization, where the Israeli forces infiltrated the Syrian lands and established security checkpoints between Khan Arnaba, Ofany and Jabot Al-Khashab Towns in Al-Quneitra countryside.

According to reliable SOHR sources, three vehicles of Israeli forces roamed the area between Al-Hamidiya and Al-Samdaniya Al-Gharbiya Villages, and stopped the passengers to search them and threaten them not to approach the borders due to the flight of drones.

The flight of Israeli drones has escalated coinciding with the flight of Iranian drones as well.
